frontcowl.name: Front cowl
frontcowl.desc: Front body over the steering valve and front fork. Daily: safety interlocks, engine oil (SAE 30), hydraulic fluid level cold, tyre pressure, hoses for leaks.

steering.name: Hydraulic power steering
steering.desc: Steering valve (Danfoss OSPM 108-2924, seal kit 106-6716) and cylinder 114-0620 (seal kit 114-0622). Priority flow from the charge pump; lift/steer relief 1100 psi. If steering is heavy, wanders or kicks back: fluid level and hoses first, then the cylinder, then the valve. Grease the cylinder rod end every 100 h.

seat.name: Seat and seat switch
seat.desc: Seat switch is part of the safety interlocks. Replace the neutral and seat interlock switches every 1500 h.

rearhood.name: Rear hood: engine (Briggs & Stratton V-twin)
rearhood.desc: Toro engine 140-0283, 2 plugs. Oil 1.66 L SAE 30 (API SL+). Every 100 h: oil and filter 107-7817 and both plugs Champion RC14YC (0.76 mm, 23 N.m; the current manual says 100 h). Air filter 108-3811 every 200 h. Every 500 h: in-line fuel filter 94-2690, carbon-canister filter 115-7854, clean the oil cooler.

frame.name: Frame and hydraulics
frame.desc: Reservoir 18.9 L Toro PX Extended Life (133-8086). On PX fluid: filter 54-0110 every 1000 h, fluid every 2000 h (800 h if any other fluid has been used). Replace moving hoses every 1500 h. Lift cylinder 115-5647 seal kit 108-4597.

frontlift.name: Front lift frame and hitch
frontlift.desc: Hydraulic front lift for the blade and other front tools. Grease all fittings every 100 h (No. 2 lithium). Check pins, springs and hoses daily.

blade.name: Front blade
blade.desc: Manual / hydraulic front blade for pushing sand. Check the cutting edge and mounting pins.

midtool.name: Mid-mount cultivator (nail plow)
midtool.desc: Lifts on the mid-mount. Check tines and pins before each use.

rake.name: Rear tooth rake
rake.desc: Carbide tine pack 119-2152. Grease the rear hitch every 100 h.

tyreF.name: Front tyre
tyreF.desc: Knobby 2-ply 85-8290 (wheel and tyre 95-0621 / 121-9077). 70 kPa (10 psi) treaded; smooth 55-70 kPa. Lug nuts 95-122 N.m at 8 h and every 100 h.

tyreR.name: Rear tyre (right)
tyreR.desc: Same tyre and pressure as the front. Wheel motor seal kit 110-6459.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Toro 104-8162. Check cable connections and electrolyte every 25 h.

107-7817: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
Champion RC14YC: Auto/small-engine parts stores or Toro dealer
106-6716: Steering valve seal kit (Danfoss OSPM valve 108-2924)

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate; the battery is not in this view and is in the parts list. The Toro photo shows a front blade, nail plow and tooth rake: check which attachments the club unit carries. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3442-260 and operator's manual 3442-255 (s/n 407600000 and up, covers this unit). Engine parts beyond filters and plugs come through Briggs & Stratton.
